Method of Attack: Phishing campaign using fake voicemail messages with embedded audio .wav files in HTML emails to lure victims into entering Microsoft Office 365 credentials; redirects users to fake Microsoft landing pages prompting login to steal credentials
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with HTML attachments containing embedded audio files and redirecting to fake login pages
Indicators of Compromise: HTML attachments with embedded .wav audio files
Phishing landing pages mimicking Microsoft login pages
Redirects to office.com after credential theft
